ValidationRule.description: se bloquea la edición de campos en prospect subsidiary para los estados que no sea draft
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Prospect_Subsidiary",
OR( ISCHANGED(Rating), ISCHANGED(CIB_Commercial_Prospect__c), ISCHANGED(DES_Legal_Entity_Type__c), ISCHANGED(DES_Main_Parent__c), ISCHANGED(gf_data_institution_type_name__c), ISCHANGED(DES_Country_of_Management_OLD__c), ISCHANGED(Name), ISCHANGED(OwnerId), ISCHANGED(DES_ID_Fiscal__c), ISCHANGED(customer_stock_exchange_name__c), ISCHANGED(Industry), ISCHANGED(Subsector__c), ISCHANGED(DES_Country_Client__c), ISCHANGED(DES_AGGR_Sector__c) ),
NOT( OR( ISPICKVAL(DES_Prospect_Status_Funnel__c, "Identify") ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The field cannot be edited in this state.
